text:
zoe: Heads-up from the SDK rollout smoke: a handful of docs still use `max_tokens` and legacy `function_call` examples. customers on Dedicated are hitting errors.

rahul: where exactly? i can patch JS snippets and the migration guide.

zoe: `snippets/js/complete.md`, `guides/migrations/v1-to-v2.md` code blocks, and `integrations/vector-stores/postgres.md` (embed dims).

miya: i'll take Python + the vector-store page. note: rwd-2 dims were 1536, rwd-3-compat is 2048 1 — we should add a reindex recipe and a bold warning.

ben: for the function-call change let's show a tiny before/after in the guide. OLD: `{ "function_call": { "name": "get_user", "arguments": "{\"id\":1}" } }` -> NEW: `{ "tool_calls": [{ "tool": "get_user", "args": { "id": 1 } }] }`. Add a note about streaming differences.

rahul: i'll open PRs and include a small codemod + sed snippet in the PR description to help integrators. planned draft deprecation copy: "Support for `max_tokens` and legacy `function_call` shape will be removed on 2026-06-30. Update by 2026-06-01." will confirm with PMs.

miya: pushed vector-store update with reindex script and a short SQL example. also added a migration checklist: replace keys, update test fixtures, run snippet smoke tests.

docs-bot: PRs opened 7201(js),7202(py),7203(migrate). CI lint passed; snippet smoke tests queued.

zoe: thanks everyone. goal: merge snippets in 48h, publish banner after merges, trigger docs rebuild and ping support/customer-success.

(THREAD END)
